newsitem.title: USA: Chevron, NGC plan La. gas venture.
newsitem.headline: Chevron, NGC plan La. gas venture.

text.p: Chevron U.S.A. Inc subsidiary Chevron U.S.A. Production Co said it and NGC Corp subsidiary Warren Petroleum Co intend to form a partnership to own, operate and expand Chevron's Venice, La. natural gas complex.

Under the conditions of a letter of intent signed by the two companies, Warren will own about a third of the partnership, operate the facility and assume commercial responsibility for the partnership, Chevron and Warren said in a statement.
Chevron will own approximately two-thirds of the partnership and continue to be one of the major producer suppliers to the Venice complex.
The companies said they are considering adding other partners to the venture.

The Venice complex is about 75 miles southeast of New Orleans. Its facilities include an offshore gas gathering system, processing plant, gas liquids fractionation facility, underground gas liquids storage facility and multi-barge gas liquids terminal.

The partnership will immediately add another gathering pipeline, expand onshore compression and condensate handling facilities and add a new cryogenic unit to expand the gas processing plant from 1.0 to 1.3 billion cubic feet per day, the companies said.
Subject to negotiations, Chevron and NGC said they expect to close the joint venture by the end of the year.
Chevron U.S.A. Inc is a subsidiary of San Francisco-based Chevron Corp. NGC is based in Houston.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
